title: Oneira: From Open-Ended Generation to Open-World Interaction in Video World Models
title_zh: Oneira：从开放式生成到视频世界模型中的开放世界交互

paragraphs.en: Generative video world models can now synthesize open-ended environments that agents can navigate and interact with in simple ways. Yet open-ended generation does not imply full interaction : as a generated world expands, newly created content through navigation should expand what the agent can act upon, and as the agent changes the world, those changes should become persistent parts of the environment rather than transient visual effects. We characterize these two requirements as Open-World Interactivity , where newly generated or encountered entities are incorporated into the actionable world, and Persistent State , where interaction outcomes are committed to the world state and continue to influence subsequent observations and interactions. We present Oneira , an interactive video world model that closes the loop between generation and interaction through an explicit, extensible world state managed by a coding agent. Given the current observation and an action or high-level goal, the agent reads the world state, grounds the relevant entities, plans the interaction, and writes its outcome back into a world state table. When exploration reveals new objects, the agent incorporates them from generated observations, allowing the interaction space to expand with the generated world. Meanwhile, previously induced state changes are carried across video segments, making the consequences of interaction persistent parts of subsequent world evolution. The updated world state is rendered along the camera action trajectory into a coarse conditioning video, from which a video generator fills in the appearance, motion, and interaction details not represented in the state. Experiments show that Oneira enables direct and consistent interaction with newly generated objects, while preserving the effects of prior interactions over long horizons. Project page: https://madaoer.github.io/projects/oneira/

paragraphs.en: Generative video world models can now produce increasingly rich environments that agents can explore, control, and interact with ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; Decart et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2025 ) . As these models move beyond fixed, preconstructed environments, however, a new question arises: how should interaction itself evolve when the world is being generated on the fly? In a conventional simulator or game engine, an object that exists in the environment is represented in an authoritative world state, and an action modifies that state. In a generative world, by contrast, newly synthesized content may exist only in the generated observations, while the effects of an action may remain only in recent visual context. The world can therefore expand visually without its space of possible interaction expanding with it.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式视频世界模型如今能够产生日益丰富的环境，智能体可以在其中探索、控制并进行交互（Valevski 等，2025；Decart 等，2024；Yang 等，2023；Parker-Holder 等，2025）。 然而，当这些模型超越固定的、预先构建的环境时，一个新的问题随之出现：当世界在被即时生成时，交互本身应如何演进？ 在传统的模拟器或游戏引擎中，存在于环境中的对象由一个权威的世界状态来表示，而动作会修改该状态。 相比之下，在生成式世界中，新合成的内容可能只存在于生成的观测之中，而动作的效果可能仅保留在近期的视觉上下文里。 因此，世界可以在视觉上不断扩张，而其可能的交互空间却并未随之扩张。

paragraphs.en: We argue that open-ended generation does not imply full interaction . A fully interactive generative world requires two properties. First, Open-World Interactivity : as exploration reveals or generates new entities, the interaction space should expand with the world, so that newly created content can become explicit targets of subsequent actions. Second, Persistent State : when an agent changes the world, the outcome of that interaction should become a durable part of the world state and continue to constrain future observations and interactions. In other words, what appears in the generated world should become actionable, and what the agent changes should remain changed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们认为，开放式生成并不意味着完全的交互。 一个完全交互式的生成世界需要具备两个属性。 第一，开放世界交互性（Open-World Interactivity）：随着探索揭示或生成新的实体，交互空间应当随世界一同扩展，使新创建的内容能够成为后续行动的明确目标。 第二，持久状态（Persistent State）：当智能体改变世界时，该交互的结果应当成为世界状态中持久的一部分，并持续约束未来的观察和交互。 换言之，生成世界中出现的事物应当是可操作的，而智能体所改变的事物应当保持被改变的状态。

paragraphs.en: Achieving both properties is difficult because existing approaches make different trade-offs. Generative video world models have rapidly expanded the range of possible controls, from camera navigation and player inputs to robot actions, language instructions, and text-specified world events ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ; Decart et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ) . Persistent memory can further improve long-horizon consistency ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) . However, the world state in these models is still largely implicit in generated pixels, prompts, or latent context. As a result, a newly generated object is not necessarily registered as an actionable world entity, and a visually plausible interaction outcome is not necessarily committed as persistent state. Explicit 3D worlds and conventional simulators provide the opposite strength: objects and their states can be referenced, modified, and preserved reliably, but the interactable world is largely determined by preconstructed geometry, assets, and interaction logic. The missing capability is therefore not merely explicit state, but an explicit state that can itself grow with the generated world .

paragraphs.en: Our contributions are threefold. (1) We introduce Oneira , an interactive video world model that enables open-world interactivity and persistent state through an explicit, extensible world state continuously updated by a coding agent. (2) We design a world state table and a coarse conditioning video as the interface between explicit world evolution and video generation, allowing instance-level interaction with newly generated objects while preserving interaction outcomes across segments. (3) We further construct a training pipeline that aligns videos with camera paths, world state tables, and chunk-level interaction captions, using the same state representation at training and inference.

paragraphs.en: Interactive video world models. Interactive video world models predict visual evolution under agent actions, spanning game controls, camera navigation, robot actions, and semantic events ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) . Recent systems improve long-horizon consistency through memory and support increasingly rich interaction. However, their primary modeling object remains the generated observation sequence, with interaction outcomes stored implicitly in pixels, latent context, or memory. In contrast, Oneira writes each interaction outcome into an explicit world state before generation and uses the video model only to render the resulting state.
paragraphs.zh: 交互式视频世界模型。 交互式视频世界模型预测智能体动作下的视觉演化，涵盖游戏操控、相机导航、机器人动作和语义事件 ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2023 ; Parker-Holder et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ; Xiong et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ) 。 近期的系统通过记忆来提升长时程一致性，并支持日益丰富的交互。 然而，它们的主要建模对象仍然是生成的观测序列，交互结果被隐式地存储在像素、潜在上下文或记忆中。 与之相反，Oneira 在生成之前将每次交互结果写入显式的世界状态，并仅使用视频模型来渲染 resulting 的状态。

paragraphs.en: Explicit world state. World models may represent dynamics in latent spaces ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ; Bardes et al., 2024 ) , but such representations are difficult to inspect or directly edit. Recent systems instead expose state through code, typed variables, simulators, or programmable scene representations ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026 ; Basant et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026c ; Huang et al., 2026b ) . Oneira differs in that a coding agent acts directly from a goal, selects which object instance changes and when, and records the resulting first-person interaction outcome in a lightweight world state table.
paragraphs.zh: 显式世界状态。 世界模型可以在潜在空间中表示动态（Hafner et al., 2019；Hafner et al., 2023；Bardes et al., 2024），但这类表征难以检查或直接编辑。 近期的系统转而通过代码、类型化变量、模拟器或可编程场景表示来暴露状态（Tang et al., 2024；Lin et al., 2026；Cai et al., 2026；Basant et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026c；Huang et al., 2026b）。 Oneira 的不同之处在于，一个编码智能体直接根据目标行动，选择哪个对象实例在何时发生变化，并将由此产生的第一人称交互结果记录在一个轻量级的世界状态表中。

paragraphs.en: Video generation from coarse conditions. Video generators can render from structured conditions such as G-buffers, 3D proxies, reprojected geometry, camera parameters, and synthetic trajectory scaffolds ( Liang et al., 2025 ; Gomez-Nogales et al., 2026 ; Yu et al., 2024 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026b ) . These conditions primarily encode geometry, layout, and viewpoint. Building on them, Oneira additionally encodes object state in the conditioning video, so that state changes are expressed directly through changes in the corresponding 3D box.
paragraphs.zh: 从粗略条件生成视频。 视频生成器可以从结构化条件进行渲染，例如 G-buffer、3D 代理、重投影几何、相机参数和合成轨迹支架（Liang et al., 2025；Gomez-Nogales et al., 2026；Yu et al., 2024；Bai et al., 2025；Xu et al., 2026；Chen et al., 2026b）。 这些条件主要编码几何、布局和视角信息。 在此基础上，Oneira 还在条件视频中编码物体状态，使状态变化能够直接通过相应 3D 框的变化来表达。

paragraphs.en: Oneira is an interactive video world model that starts from an input image I 0 I_{0} and generates an evolving world as a sequence of video segments. Our goal is to support two key properties of full interaction: Open-World Interactivity , where newly encountered objects can be incorporated into the evolving world and remain interactable, and Persistent State , where the consequences of interaction persist and influence subsequent observations. To this end, Oneira consists of four components (Fig. 2 ): 1) a coding agent A A that interprets goals and plans interactions, 2) an explicit world state table 𝒯 \mathcal{T} that records the evolving objects and their states, 3) a lightweight engine E E that executes actions, updates the state, and renders it into visual conditions, and 4) a pretrained video generator G G that realizes these conditions as realistic observations.

paragraphs.en: Explicit World State. Both Open-World Interactivity and Persistent State are realized through an explicit, evolving world state 𝒯 \mathcal{T} . The state can be extended as new objects are encountered during exploration, while interaction-induced state changes are carried forward across subsequent segments. Rather than storing visual appearance, 𝒯 \mathcal{T} maintains the interaction-relevant state of the scene, including the walkable ground and, for each object, its semantic identity, 3D position, spatial extent, orientation, presence, and state over time.
paragraphs.zh: 显式世界状态。 开放世界交互性与持久状态均通过一个显式的、不断演进的世界状态 𝒯 来实现。 当探索过程中遇到新对象时，该状态可以进行扩展，而由交互引起的状态变化会在后续片段中被持续保留。 𝒯 并不存储视觉外观，而是维护场景中与交互相关的状态，包括可行走的地面，以及每个对象的语义身份、三维位置、空间范围、朝向、存在性和随时间变化的状态。

sents.zh: 为了使生成的片段既与不断演化的世界保持状态一致、又在视觉上连贯，视频生成器以三种互补的上下文来源为条件：当前首帧 I ^ 0 ( k ) \hat{I}^{(k)}_{0}、渲染出的条件视频 V k V_{k}，以及来自更早片段的可选记忆帧 ℳ k \mathcal{M}_{k}。

sents.en: The first frame preserves the local appearance of the current scene, while V k V_{k} specifies the camera motion and the object-state changes that should be realized.
sents.zh: 首帧保留当前场景的局部外观，而 V k V_{k} 规定了应当实现的相机运动和物体状态变化。

sents.en: Following Wonder ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , V k V_{k} draws an environment sphere and a cube lattice as a camera scaffold, together with the ground grid and the object boxes of the table, whose colors encode the object states (Fig. 2 ).
sents.zh: 遵循 Wonder（Xu et al., 2026），V k V_{k} 绘制一个环境球体和一个立方体晶格作为相机支架，连同地面网格和桌子的物体框，其颜色编码物体状态（图 2）。

sents.en: For longer-range consistency, we retrieve memory frames from previously observed views, but retain only those whose object states agree with the current world state 𝒯 k \mathcal{T}_{k} .
sents.zh: 为了更长程的一致性，我们从先前观察到的视角中检索记忆帧，但只保留那些物体状态与当前世界状态 𝒯 k \mathcal{T}_{k} 相符的帧。

sents.en: This prevents stale visual evidence from contradicting interaction-induced state changes.
sents.zh: 这可以防止过时的视觉证据与交互引发的状态变化相矛盾。

paragraphs.en: To make a pretrained video model natively understand our world-state conditions. We therefore fine-tune the generator on videos paired with the same conditions used at inference, so that it learns to follow the prescribed camera motion, target object, interaction timing, and resulting object state while retaining its pretrained visual and motion priors. Because the object-state conditions are category-agnostic , the learned interaction control can also transfer to object categories unseen during fine-tuning. Data construction and training details are provided in Section 4 and Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 为了让预训练视频模型原生地理解我们的世界状态条件。 因此，我们在与推理时所用相同条件配对的视频上对生成器进行微调，使其学会遵循规定的相机运动、目标物体、交互时机以及由此产生的物体状态，同时保留其预训练的视觉与运动先验。 由于物体状态条件与类别无关，所学到的交互控制还可以迁移到微调期间未见过的物体类别上。 数据构建与训练细节见第 4 节和附录 B。

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune the MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA ( MiniMax-AI, 2026 ) backbone with a LoRA ( Hu et al., 2021 ) of rank 128 on the attention projections of the DiT. The conditioning video is rendered at 448 × 256 448\times 256 in both training and inference, while the generated video has 832 × 480 832\times 480 pixels. Training uses 32 clips per step and a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} (see details in Appendix B ). We use Claude Opus 4.8 as the coding agent, and it builds the world state table with off-the-shelf perception models. It plans every action in our experiments from the first frame and the action text, and the engine executes the action and renders the conditioning video with OpenGL.

paragraphs.en: We build InteractionBench to test the interaction and memory abilities of video world models. It has 100 interaction cases and 50 memory cases, and GPT-Image-2 generates every first frame. Each interaction case pairs a first frame with one or two action from our 12 action categories. The interaction cases come in a single-target group of 50 and a multi-target group of 50. Each multi-target case holds five identical objects of one kind, or three identical objects of each of two kinds. Each memory case is a chain of two segments and lasts 20 seconds. The first segment performs an interaction, and the second segment turns the camera away and returns it to a pose visited after the interaction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 InteractionBench 来测试视频世界模型的交互与记忆能力。 它包含 100 个交互案例和 50 个记忆案例，每个首帧均由 GPT-Image-2 生成。 每个交互案例将一个首帧与我们 12 个动作类别中的一个或两个动作配对。 交互案例分为 50 个单目标组和 50 个多目标组。 每个多目标案例包含五个同类相同物体，或两类物体各三个相同物体。 每个记忆案例由两段组成的链条构成，持续 20 秒。 第一段执行一次交互，第二段将相机转开，然后回到交互后曾经过的一个位姿。

paragraphs.en: Our baselines are the MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA backbone and three interactive video world models, LingBot-World-V2 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , YUME 1.5 ( Mao et al., 2026 ) , and AlayaWorld ( Team et al., 2026a ) . These video world models all support interactive events. We convert the first frame, the camera path, and the action text into the input format of each baseline. LingBot-World-V2 and AlayaWorld receive our camera path as per-frame poses, while YUME 1.5 and MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA take no poses and receive the camera motion as text per chunk. In the memory part, MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA receives the same number of memory frames as Oneira .

paragraphs.en: On the interaction part, we define three scores, Interaction, Timing, and Target. Interaction asks whether the specified action takes place, Timing evaluates whether any action begins in the specified chunk, and Target evaluates whether the changed instance is the target object. We score Interaction and Timing with Gemini 3.7 Flash ( Team et al., 2023 ) as the VLM judge on the generated frames. For Target, we follow our data pipeline to build the world state table on the generated video and check which instance changes. On the memory part, PSNR and SSIM between the visit and revisit frames at the same pose measure global consistency. State asks the judge whether the target object keeps its changed state. For visual quality, we report eight VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) dimensions on all 150 cases (see details in Appendix D ).
paragraphs.zh: 在交互部分，我们定义了三个分数：Interaction（交互）、Timing（时机）和 Target（目标）。 Interaction 判断指定的动作是否发生，Timing 评估是否有动作在指定的分块中开始，Target 评估发生变化的实例是否为目标对象。 我们使用 Gemini 3.7 Flash（Team et al., 2023）作为 VLM 评审，对生成的帧进行 Interaction 和 Timing 打分。 对于 Target，我们沿用我们的数据流水线，在生成的视频上构建世界状态表，并检查哪个实例发生了变化。 在记忆部分，同一位姿下访问帧与重访帧之间的 PSNR 和 SSIM 用于衡量全局一致性。 State 让评审判断目标对象是否保持其变化后的状态。 在视觉质量方面，我们在全部 150 个案例上报告 VBench（Huang et al., 2024）的八个维度（详见附录 D）。

paragraphs.en: (1) We synthesize first-person videos of 12 state-changing actions with proprietary video models. (2) We incorporate navigation videos from two public datasets, the real walking videos of Sekai ( Li et al., 2025 ) and the game footage of ABot ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . About 60% of the clips are interaction and 40% navigation, at 832 × 480 832\times 480 and 24 fps, and about 1K clips of both kinds come with memory frames of the same place.
paragraphs.zh: (1) 我们使用专有视频模型合成了 12 种状态改变动作的第一人称视频。 (2) 我们纳入了来自两个公开数据集的导航视频，即 Sekai 的真实行走视频（Li et al., 2025）和 ABot 的游戏画面（Jiang et al., 2026）。 其中约 60% 的片段为交互类，40% 为导航类，分辨率为 832 × 480 832\times 480、帧率 24 fps，并且两类各有约 1K 个片段附带同一地点的记忆帧。

sents.en: (2) We incorporate navigation videos from two public datasets, the real walking videos of Sekai ( Li et al., 2025 ) and the game footage of ABot ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) .

paragraphs.en: LingBot-Map ( Chen et al., 2026a ) estimates the camera poses and depth, MoGe-2 ( Wang et al., 2025a ) the metric scale, GeoCalib ( Veicht et al., 2024 ) the gravity direction, SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) the masks of the ground and the named objects, and WildDet3D ( Huang et al., 2026a ) lifts each object to a 3D box in world coordinates. Moreover, we use Gemini 3.7 Flash to determine the start, duration, and end of each action as its action label.
paragraphs.zh: LingBot-Map（Chen et al., 2026a）估计相机位姿和深度，MoGe-2（Wang et al., 2025a）估计度量尺度，GeoCalib（Veicht et al., 2024）估计重力方向，SAM3（Carion et al., 2026）估计地面和命名对象的掩码，而 WildDet3D（Huang et al., 2026a）将每个对象提升为世界坐标系中的三维框。 此外，我们使用 Gemini 3.7 Flash 来确定每个动作的开始、持续时间和结束，作为其动作标签。

sents.zh: 此外，我们使用 Gemini 3.7 Flash 来确定每个动作的开始、持续时间和结束，作为其动作标签。

paragraphs.en: For each video, Gemini 3.7 Flash writes a checklist for physical plausibility and the correctness of the action, and then judges the video against it. We also check for scene cuts and aesthetics, and we discard every clip that fails. Following LingBot-World ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , the global caption describes the scene without any camera motion or interaction, and these dynamics come only from the conditioning video and the chunk captions.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个视频，Gemini 3.7 Flash 会为物理合理性和动作正确性编写一份检查清单，然后据此对视频进行评判。 我们还会检查场景切换和美学质量，并丢弃所有不达标的片段。 遵循 LingBot-World（Gao et al., 2026），全局描述仅描述场景本身，不包含任何镜头运动或交互，这些动态内容仅来自条件视频和分块描述。

sents.en: Following LingBot-World ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , the global caption describes the scene without any camera motion or interaction, and these dynamics come only from the conditioning video and the chunk captions.

paragraphs.en: To keep training and inference consistent, we build a world state table for each clean clip and render the conditioning video from it. The table records each object by its semantic label, one 3D box in world coordinates for its position and size, and its state in each chunk. The engine renders the video along the estimated camera path and composes the chunk captions with the same code as at inference.

paragraphs.en: In Table 1 , we present the results on InteractionBench, evaluating every method with the protocol of Section 4.1 . On the interaction part, Oneira reaches the highest rate on all three scores. Oneira outperforms the best baseline by 0.29 in Interaction, 0.19 in Timing, and 0.29 in Target. The baselines often start some action in the specified chunk, since Timing exceeds Interaction for three of them, but the change is the wrong one or falls on the wrong instance. These results show the advantage of our representation for world modeling. The world state table encodes the world explicitly and efficiently in an abstract, structured form, and this form helps the model keep the correct time and target of each interaction. For the memory part, Oneira improves PSNR by 93%, SSIM by 83%, and State by 18% over the second-best method. MiniMax-H3 Ref2VA keeps the changed state with the memory frames and reaches a State of 0.68, but it has no camera control, so its revisit frame comes from a different pose and its PSNR and SSIM stay low. The other baselines cannot keep an updated world state for long once the camera turns away, so the scene and the changed state drift by the revisit. By contrast, Oneira maintains the updated state across segments with the world state table and the memory frames, and the camera returns to the same pose. On VBench, Oneira improves subject consistency and overall consistency by 2.14% and 8.58%, respectively, over the strongest baseline for each metric, while achieving the highest motion smoothness, supporting coherent, smooth, and text-aligned video generation under explicit state conditioning.

paragraphs.en: Fig. 3 demonstrates a qualitative comparison between our method and the baselines on a chain of three segments over 30 seconds. paragraphs.en: We perform an ablation study to evaluate the contributions of the key components of our framework. We train three variants, each with one condition of the video model removed, and evaluate them on the interaction part of InteractionBench. Ours w/o sphere removes the environment sphere and the cube lattice from the conditioning video, to observe their effect on camera motion. Ours w/o boxes removes the object boxes, to observe their effect on the accuracy of the interaction. Ours w/o chunk captions removes the chunk captions and states the time of the action in the global caption. RotErr and TransErr follow the camera accuracy protocol of SANA-WM ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) (see details in Appendix D ). Table 2 shows the quantitative comparison between our full method and these variants. Ours w/o sphere loses most of the cues to the camera motion, so the motion becomes ambiguous and camera control drops sharply. The wrong camera motion also lowers its interaction scores. Ours w/o boxes lacks the instance-level condition, so the model has to pick the target instance from the action text alone and often changes a wrong object. Ours w/o chunk captions shows that a prompt alone does not place the action accurately in time, since the global caption states the time only as text and the model has to guess the chunk.
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行消融实验来评估框架中各个关键组件的贡献。 我们训练了三个变体，每个变体从条件视频中移除视频模型的一种条件，并在 InteractionBench 的交互部分上进行评估。 Ours w/o sphere 从条件视频中移除环境球体和立方体网格，以观察它们对相机运动的影响。 Ours w/o boxes 移除物体框，以观察它们对交互准确性的影响。 Ours w/o chunk captions 移除片段描述，并在全局描述中说明动作的时间。 RotErr 和 TransErr 遵循 SANA-WM（Zhu 等，2026）的相机精度评估协议（详见附录 D）。 表 2 展示了我们的完整方法与这些变体之间的定量比较。 Ours w/o sphere 失去了大部分相机运动的线索，因此运动变得模糊，相机控制能力急剧下降。 错误的相机运动也降低了其交互得分。 Ours w/o boxes 缺少实例级条件，因此模型只能从动作文本中选择目标实例，经常会改变错误的物体。 Ours w/o chunk captions 表明仅凭提示无法在时间上准确定位动作，因为全局描述仅以文本形式陈述时间，模型不得不猜测所在的片段。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we proposed Oneira , a generative video world model that allows full interaction, with the ability to maintain a world state which maintains the influence of interactions on subsequent observations and interactions. Experiments show we make it successful in open-world interactivity and state continuity. The newly generated objects can be interacted with, and the changes to those objects can be reflected in future observations. One of the limitations is that in Oneira , the current action space is still discrete. Future work could extend the framework to more fine-grained physical interactions and continuous-control settings, such as precise manipulation and robot control. The physical realism of complex interactions is likewise limited by the learned dynamics of the video model rather than an explicit physics simulator. While the explicit world state improves the persistence of interaction outcomes, long-horizon visual consistency is still bounded by the underlying video generator. Therefore, we plan to design more data to improve the pretrained video models.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 Oneira，一个可完全交互的生成式视频世界模型，它能够维护一个世界状态，以保持交互对后续观测和交互的影响。 实验表明，我们在开放世界交互性和状态连续性方面取得了成功。 新生成的物体可以被交互，并且对这些物体的更改可以反映在未来的观测中。 局限性之一在于，Oneira 目前的动作空间仍然是离散的。 未来的工作可以将该框架扩展到更细粒度的物理交互和连续控制场景，例如精确操作和机器人控制。 复杂交互的物理真实性同样受限于视频模型学习到的动力学，而非显式的物理模拟器。 尽管显式的世界状态提升了交互结果的持久性，但长期视觉一致性仍受限于底层的视频生成器。 因此，我们计划设计更多数据来改进预训练的视频模型。

paragraphs.en: This work studies interactive video world models and does not involve human subjects or the collection of personally identifiable information. The models developed in this work may inherit biases and limitations from their pretrained components and training data. More capable generative world models could also potentially be misused to generate misleading or synthetic visual content. We therefore emphasize responsible use of the proposed system for research and simulation purposes and encourage appropriate safeguards when deploying such models in real-world applications.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究致力于交互式视频世界模型，不涉及人类受试者，也不收集个人身份信息。 本研究所开发的模型可能会从其预训练组件和训练数据中继承偏见与局限性。 能力更强的生成式世界模型也可能被滥用，用于生成误导性或合成的视觉内容。 因此，我们强调应负责任地将所提出的系统用于研究和仿真目的，并鼓励在现实应用中部署此类模型时采取适当的防护措施。

paragraphs.en: Interactive video world models predict how an environment evolves under the actions of an agent. Game world models condition generation on player inputs ( Valevski et al., 2025 ; Decart et al., 2024 ; Alonso et al., 2024 ; Guo et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2026b ) , and camera-controlled systems extend exploration to minute-long rollouts that remain consistent upon revisits ( Sun et al., 2025 ; Hong et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ; Xiao et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ) . UniSim ( Yang et al., 2023 ) conditions generation on robot actions and language instructions, and DreamGen ( Jang et al., 2025 ) generates robot data for policy learning. Genie 3 and related systems support text-triggered world events ( Parker-Holder et al., 2025 ; Xiang et al., 2025 ; Mao et al., 2026 ) , ActWorld ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) adds action-aware memory to preserve modified object states, and LingBot-World 2.0 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) places agents that issue semantic actions inside the rollout. These advances strengthen control, memory, and agentic interaction around a learned visual rollout. Their central modeling object, however, remains the generated observation sequence. Interaction outcomes are represented only implicitly in visual history, latent context, or memory tokens, and they cannot be verified against an explicit specification. Oneira specifies the outcome of each interaction in a world state table before generation and uses the video model to render it.

paragraphs.en: A second line of work models the effect of actions in a space other than pixels. Model-based reinforcement learning learns world dynamics in a latent space ( Hafner et al., 2019 ; Hafner et al., 2023 ) , and V-JEPA predicts video in a representation space ( Bardes et al., 2024 ) . These learned abstractions are hard to interpret, and an intended outcome can be neither written into them nor decoded from them. Recent work represents the state explicitly. Program-based world models express dynamics as code that an agent can inspect and revise ( Tang et al., 2024 ; Lehrach et al., 2026 ) . For interactive video, StatePlay ( Lin et al., 2026 ) jointly predicts observations and game-state variables, and MASS ( Cai et al., 2026 ) advances a typed state with a learned logic engine. OmniDreams ( Basant et al., 2026 ) conditions closed-loop driving simulation on a rendered abstract state of lane lines and road actors. This state is derived from a traffic simulator and driving logs, and its changes are limited to the motion of road actors. Concurrently, Code World Model ( Chen et al., 2026c ) uses a coding agent to maintain world state through code and compiles the state into a proxy video. Programmable World Model ( Huang et al., 2026b ) compiles state-augmented 3D bounding boxes into controls for a video renderer. In both systems, the agent programs the entity states and the transition rules of a playable world, and a player acts in it. In Oneira , the rules are fixed in a lightweight engine, and the coding agent itself acts from a goal, deciding which object instance changes and when. It targets the state changes that first-person interactions cause to objects, and encodes each change as the removal or recoloring of a 3D box in the conditioning video.

paragraphs.en: Video models can serve as renderers for structured conditions of varying explicitness. Wonder ( Xu et al., 2026 ) renders a synthetic lattice and an environment map along the trajectory, so that the model interprets camera motion directly as visual evidence. At the other end of this spectrum, a white-box world built in a 3D engine drives a frozen video model frame by frame ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . These conditions specify geometry, layout, and viewpoint, and they carry no explicit notion of object state. Oneira follows the camera scaffold of Wonder and encodes the state of each object in the same conditioning video as a colored box. A state change appears as the removal or recoloring of that box.

paragraphs.en: We fine-tune the backbone with fully sharded data parallelism in its hybrid form over 32 GPUs, one clip per GPU, so a step sees 32 clips. Each clip has 243 frames encoded into 72 latent frames, 9 per chunk, and the first frame and the conditioning video enter through the reference inputs of the backbone, packed ahead of the video latents with its official packed-sequence builder. The LoRA has rank 128 on the attention projections and the learning rate is 10 − 4 10^{-4} . In half of the training steps we fix the first frame as at inference, and in the other half we leave it free, so the model keeps its generative ability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们以混合形式的完全分片数据并行在 32 块 GPU 上对骨干网络进行微调，每块 GPU 一个片段，因此一步会看到 32 个片段。 每个片段包含 243 帧，编码为 72 个潜在帧，每块 9 帧，首帧和条件视频通过骨干网络的参考输入进入，并使用其官方打包序列构建器打包在视频潜在表示之前。 LoRA 在注意力投影上的秩为 128，学习率为 10 − 4 10^{-4} 。 在一半的训练步骤中，我们像推理时那样固定首帧，在另一半步骤中则让其保持自由，从而保持模型的生成能力。

paragraphs.en: The global caption and the eight chunk captions are concatenated into one text sequence, and a block-causal mask lets the video tokens of chunk c c attend to the global caption and to the captions of chunks up to c c , following the chunk-wise captions of LingBot-World-V2 ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . A chunk caption contains an action sentence and an outcome sentence, such as A hand picks up the red apple. followed by The apple has left the table. The global caption contains one fixed passage shared by every sample, which explains each element of the conditioning video, including the meaning of the three colors and of a disappearing box.
paragraphs.zh: 全局字幕与八个分块字幕被拼接成一个文本序列，并且采用分块因果掩码，使分块 c 的视频 token 可以关注全局字幕以及截至分块 c 的各分块字幕，遵循 LingBot-World-V2（Gao et al., 2026）的分块字幕方式。 每个分块字幕包含一个动作句子和一个结果句子，例如先是「一只手拿起红苹果。」，随后是「苹果已离开桌子。」。 全局字幕包含一段每个样本共享的固定文本，该文本解释了条件视频中的各个元素，包括三种颜色的含义以及一个会消失的方框的含义。

paragraphs.en: For each training video, LingBot-Map ( Chen et al., 2026a ) estimates the camera poses and depth, and GeoCalib ( Veicht et al., 2024 ) estimates the gravity direction. MoGe-2 ( Wang et al., 2025a ) provides the metric scale. SAM3 ( Carion et al., 2026 ) segments the named objects and the walkable ground, and WildDet3D ( Huang et al., 2026a ) lifts the objects to 3D bounding boxes in world coordinates. We fit the ground plane to the ground points with RANSAC constrained by the gravity direction and grow its walkable region across the clip. For each chunk, Gemini 3.7 Flash reports whether an action begins, whether the target has left its position, and whether a state change is under way. From these answers we assemble the event chunk, the transition window, and the chunk captions with fixed rules, so the captions and the conditioning video are consistent by construction.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每段训练视频，LingBot-Map（Chen et al., 2026a）估计相机位姿和深度，GeoCalib（Veicht et al., 2024）估计重力方向。 MoGe-2（Wang et al., 2025a）提供公制尺度。 SAM3（Carion et al., 2026）分割指定物体和可行走地面，WildDet3D（Huang et al., 2026a）将物体提升到世界坐标系中的三维边界框。 我们在重力方向约束下用 RANSAC 将地面平面拟合到地面点上，并在整个片段中扩展其可行走区域。 对于每个分块，Gemini 3.7 Flash 报告是否有动作开始、目标是否已离开其位置、以及是否正在进行状态变化。 我们根据这些回答按照固定规则组装事件分块、过渡窗口和分块描述，因此描述与条件视频在构造上就是一致的。

paragraphs.en: The training set holds about 5800 interaction clips and about 4200 navigation clips. When we synthesize the interaction clips with the proprietary video models, each prompt combines one of the 12 action categories with a target object and a scene, and we balance the prompts over the actions, the scenes, and the chunk in which the interaction begins. The model therefore sees interactions early, midway, and late in a clip. Fig. 5 shows the share of clips per action category.
paragraphs.zh: 训练集包含约 5800 个交互片段和约 4200 个导航片段。 当我们使用自研视频模型合成交互片段时，每个提示词将 12 个动作类别之一与一个目标物体和一个场景组合，并且我们在动作、场景以及交互开始的片段区间上对提示词进行了均衡。 因此，模型会在片段的早期、中期和后期观察到交互。 图 5 展示了各动作类别片段的占比。

paragraphs.en: The navigation pool holds about 4200 clips and supplies camera motion in scenes where nothing happens, real walking videos from Sekai ( Li et al., 2025 ) and first-person game captures with recorded camera poses ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . Backward and sideways motion is rare in real walking videos, so most of these clips come from the game footage. We filter the pool in three steps. TransNetV2 ( Soucek and Lokoc, 2024 ) removes clips with a shot change, DOVER ( Wu et al., 2023 ) scores aesthetic and technical quality and removes the low end, and the optical flow of UniMatch ( Xu et al., 2023 ) removes clips with too little or too much motion. Gemini 3.7 Flash then rejects clips with glare, darkness, overlays, blank frames, a dominant foreground object, or a focus or zoom shift, and it counts the people and vehicles in each clip, so we keep clips with few of them, a straight path, and enough visible ground. Finally, we estimate the camera path with LingBot-Map and MoGe-2 as in Section 4.2 and reject clips whose camera height or displacement falls outside a plausible range. In the clips that remain, the table also contains the people and vehicles, whose boxes follow fitted trajectories, and every chunk caption is the placeholder Nothing happens.
paragraphs.zh: 导航池包含约 4200 个片段，为没有任何事件发生的场景提供相机运动，包括来自 Sekai（Li et al., 2025）的真实行走视频和带有记录相机位姿的第一人称游戏采集（Jiang et al., 2026）。 后退和侧向运动在真实行走视频中很少见，因此这些片段大多来自游戏画面。 我们通过三个步骤对片段池进行过滤。 TransNetV2（Soucek and Lokoc, 2024）移除含有镜头切换的片段，DOVER（Wu et al., 2023）对美学和技术质量打分并移除低分片段，UniMatch（Xu et al., 2023）的光流则移除运动过少或过多的片段。 Gemini 3.7 Flash 随后拒绝带有眩光、黑暗、叠加层、空白帧、占主导地位的前景物体或焦点和变焦变化的片段，并统计每个片段中的人和车辆的数量，因此我们保留其中人和车辆较少、路径笔直且可见地面充足的片段。 最后，我们按照第 4.2 节的方法用 LingBot-Map 和 MoGe-2 估计相机路径，并拒绝相机高度或位移超出合理范围的片段。 在保留下来的片段中，表格同样包含人和车辆，其边界框遵循拟合的轨迹，且每个分块描述都是占位符 Nothing happens。

paragraphs.en: Interaction and Timing. Gemini 3.7 Flash reads six frames sampled uniformly from each chunk, together with the last two frames of the chunk before it as context, and the action text. For each chunk, it reports the hand action it sees and the kind of change it sees, each from a fixed list, and whether the specified change has taken place, with the prompt shown in Fig. 6 . Interaction counts a case as correct if in some chunk the change and the hand action match the ones expected for the action category and a hand performs the action. Timing counts a case as correct if the first chunk in which the judge sees an action begin is the specified chunk.
paragraphs.zh: 交互与时机。 Gemini 3.7 Flash 从每个分块中均匀采样读取六帧，连同其前一个分块的末两帧作为上下文，以及动作文本。 对于每个分块，它报告所看到的手部动作和所看到的变动类型（各自来自固定列表），以及指定的变动是否已发生，提示词如图 6 所示。 交互（Interaction）判定一个用例正确，条件是：在某个分块中，变动与手部动作均与该动作类别所预期的相匹配，且有手部执行该动作。 时机（Timing）判定一个用例正确，条件是：评审者看到动作开始的首个分块正是指定的分块。

sents.zh: 交互与时机。

paragraphs.en: Target. We run the 3D perception of our data pipeline on each generated video and build its world state table, which gives every object instance a 3D box in the world coordinates anchored at the first frame and a state per chunk. The specification fixes the target instance by its box in the table built from the first frame, so we match the instance that changes its state in the generated video to that box. Target counts a case as correct if the changed instance is the specified one, whatever the change is. For the baselines, we name the specific target object in the action text.
paragraphs.zh: 目标。 我们对每个生成的视频运行数据管线的 3D 感知，并构建其世界状态表，为每个物体实例提供一个锚定在第一帧的世界坐标系下的 3D 边界框，以及每个分块的状态。 规范通过由第一帧构建的表中的边界框来确定目标实例，因此我们将生成视频中状态发生变化的实例与该边界框进行匹配。 目标将变化的实例为指定实例的情况计为正确，无论变化是什么。 对于基线方法，我们在动作文本中指明具体的目标物体。

paragraphs.en: Visual quality. We run VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) in custom-input mode on all 150 videos and report subject consistency (SC), background consistency (BC), motion smoothness (MS), temporal flickering (TF), dynamic degree (DD), aesthetic quality (AQ), imaging quality (IQ), and overall consistency (OC).
